'''Linh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] operative of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], she was sent by fellow Intelligence operative [[Lycus Mattle]] to contact [[Cipher Nine|another operative]] posing as the [[Red Blade]], and to pass along Mattle's location and advice.<ref name="Friends in Common" />
